titulo: Patient seeks protection
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons seeking protection.

titulo: Undergoing elective splenectomy
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are undergoing elective splenectomy if they have not previously received the vaccine.
texto_esclarecimento: Vaccination 14 or more days before splenectomy is suggested

titulo: Immunocompromised
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient is immunocompromised.

titulo: Recipient of a hematopoietic stem cell transplant
texto_indicacao: Administer to recipients of a hematopoietic stem cell transplant [HSCT] 6 to 12 months after a successful transplant, regardless of vaccination history.

titulo: Hepatitis C virus infection
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons with a hepatitis C virus infection.

titulo: Receives clotting factor concentrates
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who receive clotting factor concentrates.

titulo: Pregnant
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are pregnant.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient is pregnant.

titulo: Travel to an area of active cholera transmission
texto_indicacao: Administer to travelers from the United States traveling to an area of active cholera transmission.
texto_esclarecimento: An area of active cholera transmission is defined as a province, state, or other administrative subdivision within a country with endemic or epidemic cholera caused by toxigenic V. cholerae O1 and includes areas with cholera activity within the last year that are prone to recurrence of cholera epidemics; it does not include areas where only rare imported or sporadic cases have been reported.

titulo: Breastfeeding
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient is breastfeeding.

titulo: Cerebrospinal fluid leaks
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have cerebrospinal fluid leaks.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has cerebrospinal fluid leaks.

titulo: Cochlear implants
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have cochlear implants.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has cochlear implants.

titulo: Family history of altered immunocompetence
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a family history of altered immunocompetence
texto_esclarecimento: Harmonizes with the vaccine-specific statements in accommodating infants and toddlers with occult heritable congenital immunodeficiencies.

titulo: Severe Combined Immunodeficiency [SCID]
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has Severe Combined Immunodeficiency [SCID].

titulo: Diabetes
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have diabetes.

titulo: Chronic liver disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have chronic liver disease.
texto_esclarecimento: Includes cirrhosis

titulo: Chronic heart disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have chronic heart disease.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate persons who have chronic heart disease.
texto_esclarecimento: e.g. congestive heart failure and cardiomyopathies, excluding hypertension

titulo: Chronic lung disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have chronic lung disease.
texto_esclarecimento: e.g. chronic obstructive lung disease, emphysema but not asthma

Laboratory Evidence of Immunity or confirmation of Hepatitis B disease

Laboratory Evidence of Immunity for Rubella

Persons with perinatal HIV infection who do not have evidence of severe immunosuppression and who were vaccinated with MMR before establishment of antiviral therapy [ART]
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons with perinatal HIV infection who do not have evidence of severe immunosuppression and who were vaccinated with MMR before establishment of antiviral therapy [ART].

titulo: Asthma
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have asthma.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has asthma.

titulo: Intussusception
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has intussusception.
texto_esclarecimento: Includes history of uncorrected congenital malformation of the gastrointestinal tract that would predispose the infant to intussusception or history of intussusception.

titulo: Acute gastroenteritis
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has acute gastroenteritis.

titulo: Acute febrile illness
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has acute febrile illness.

titulo: Tuberculosis
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have tuberculosis
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has active untreated tuberculosis.

titulo: Dialysis patient
texto_indicacao: Administer to hemodialysis patients and predialysis, peritoneal dialysis, and home dialysis patients

titulo: Taken influenza antiviral medications within the previous 48 hours
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has taken influenza antiviral medications  within the previous 48 hours.
texto_esclarecimento: e.g. amantadine, rimantadine, zanamivir, or oseltamivir

titulo: Receiving long-term aspirin therapy
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient is receiving long-term aspirin therapy.

titulo: Antimicrobial or antimalarial taken within 72 hours
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient  has taken antimicrobial or antimalarial medications  within the previous 72 hours.
texto_esclarecimento: A longer interval should be considered for long-acting antimicrobials [e.g., the antimalarial agents mefloquine and chloroquine and the combinations atovaquone/proguanil and pyrimethamine/sulfadoxine can, at doses used for prophylaxis, be administered together with the Ty21a vaccine; however, the manufacturer advises that other antimalarial agents only be administered at least 3 days after the last vaccine dose).

titulo: Men who have sex with men
texto_indicacao: Administer to men who have sex with men.

titulo: Not in a long-term, mutually monogamous relationship
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons not in a long-term, mutually monogamous relationship.
texto_esclarecimento: e.g. persons with more than 1 sex partner during the previous 6 months

titulo: Sex partner of Hepatitis B surface antigen-positive persons
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are a sex partner of a Hepatitis B surface antigen-positive person.

titulo: Receives treatment for STD
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who receive treatment for STD.

titulo: Illicit drug use
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who use illicit drugs.
texto_esclarecimento: Includes injection and noninjection illicit drugs

titulo: Illicit injection drug use
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who use illicit injection drugs.

titulo: Smoke cigarettes
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who smoke cigarettes.

titulo: Alcoholism
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have alcoholism.

titulo: Anticipate close personal contact with international adoptee
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who anticipate close personal contact with an international adoptee during the first 60 days.
texto_esclarecimento:
e.g., household or regular babysitting
Applies when adoptee is from a country with high or intermediate endemicity

titulo: Travel to country with a Yellow Fever vaccination entry requirement
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who travel to a country with a Yellow Fever vaccination entry requirement.
texto_esclarecimento: A list of country-specific requirements is available at https://www.cdc.gov/yellow-book/hcp/travel-associated-infections-diseases/yellow-fever.html

titulo: College students living in residence halls
texto_indicacao: Administer to college students living in residence halls.

titulo: Resident of area at risk for exposure to the disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to residents of an area at risk for exposure to the disease.

titulo: Travelling Internationally
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who will be travelling internationally.

titulo: Working with Hepatitis A virus in research setting
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who work with Hepatitis A virus in a research setting.
texto_esclarecimento: Includes working with HAV-infected primates or with HAV in a research laboratory setting

titulo: Microbiologists routinely exposed to Neisseria meningitidis
texto_indicacao: Administer to microbiologists routinely exposed to isolates of Neisseria meningitidis.

titulo: Microbiology laboratorians who work frequently with S. typhi
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are microbiology laboratorians who work frequently with S. typhi.

titulo: Laboratory personnel who might be exposed to YFV
texto_indicacao: Administer to laboratory personnel who might be exposed to virulent YFV or to concentrated preparations of YF vaccine virus strains by direct or indirect contact or by aerosols.

titulo: Rabies researchers
texto_indicacao: Administer to Rabies researchers.

titulo: Laboratory workers who handle specimens that might contain polioviruses
texto_indicacao: Administer to laboratory workers who handle specimens that might contain polioviruses.

titulo: Health care personnel
texto_indicacao: Administer to healthcare personnel without evidence of immunity.
texto_esclarecimento: A general definition of health care personnel is given in the National Healthcare Safety Network [NHSN] manual [https://www.cdc.gov/nhsn/pdfs/hps-manual/hps_manual-exp-plus-flu-portfolio.pdf] in the definitions section.

titulo: Health-care workers who have close contact with patients who might be excreting wild polioviruses
texto_indicacao: Administer to health-care workers who have close contact with patients who might be excreting wild polioviruses.

titulo: Public safety worker exposed to blood or infection body fluids
texto_indicacao: Administer to public safety workers exposed to blood or infection body fluids

titulo: Staff of institution for persons with developmental disabilities
texto_indicacao: Administer to staff of institution for persons with developmental disabilities

titulo: Occupational exposure for Hepatitis A
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have an occupational exposure for Hepatitis A
texto_esclarecimento: Consideration may be given to vaccination of employees who work in areas where state and local health authorities or private employers determine that such vaccination is appropriate.

titulo: Veterinarians and their staff
texto_indicacao: Administer to veterinarians and their staff.

titulo: Animal handlers
texto_indicacao: Administer to animal handlers.

titulo: Persons whose activities bring them into frequent contact with rabies virus or potentially rabid animals
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons whose activities bring them into frequent contact with rabies virus or potentially rabid animals.
texto_esclarecimento: Occupational or recreational activities that typically involve contact with animals include 1) veterinarians, technicians, animal control officers, and their students or trainees; 2) persons who handle wildlife reservoir species (e.g., wildlife biologists, rehabilitators, and trappers); and 3) spelunkers

titulo: Post secondary student
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are students in a postsecondary educational institution.

titulo: Military recruits
texto_indicacao: Administer to military recruits.

titulo: Client of institution for persons with developmental disabilities
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are a client of institution for persons with developmental disabilities.

titulo: Chronic renal failure
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons with chronic renal failure.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has chronic renal failure.

titulo: In drug abuse treatment and prevention facility
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are in a drug abuse treatment and prevention facility.

titulo: In correctional facility
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are in a correctional facility.

titulo: Persons at risk during an outbreak
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons identified as at increased risk during a community outbreak attributable to a vaccine serogroup.

titulo: Household contact with hepatitis B surface antigen-positive persons
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have household contact with hepatitis B surface antigen-positive persons.

titulo: Intimate exposure to a documented S. typhi carrier
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have intimate exposure to a documented S. typhi carrier.
texto_esclarecimento: e.g., household contact

titulo: Household and close contacts of immunocompromised persons
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are household and close contacts of immunocompromised persons.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if potential vaccinee has a household contact who is immunocompromised. Household contacts include persons with prolonged intimate contact with the potential vaccinee (e.g., sexual contacts) and others who might have direct contact with the vaccination site or with potentially contaminated materials (e.g., dressings or clothing).

titulo: Negative serological screening for varicella
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are serologically negative for varicella.

titulo: Transgender person
texto_indicacao: Administer to transgender persons.

titulo: Progressive neurologic disorder
texto_contraindicacao:
Do not vaccinate if the patient has progressive neurologic disorder until a treatment regimen has been
established and the condition has stabilized.
texto_esclarecimento:
Includes infantile spasms, uncontrolled epilepsy, or progressive encephalopathy for the administration of any pertussis-containing
vaccine

titulo: Received inactivated or unknown measles vaccine between 1963-1967
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who received inactivated or unknown measles vaccine between 1963-1967.

titulo: Received killed or unknown Mumps vaccine before 1979
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who received killed or unknown Mumps vaccine before 1979.

titulo: Encephalopathy not attributable to another identifiable cause within 7 days of administration of a previous dose of Tdap, DTP, or DTaP vaccine
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had encephalopathy not attributable to another identifiable cause within 7 days of administration of a previous dose of Tdap, DTP, or DTaP vaccine.

titulo: Adverse reaction to vaccine component
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had an adverse reaction to a vaccine component.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of Polio vaccine.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a history of egg allergy.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to arginine.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to streptomycin.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to polymyxin B.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a hypersensitivity to yeast.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a hypersensitivity to the preservative 2-phenoxyethanol.

titulo: Hypersensitivity to alum
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a hypersensitivity to alum.
texto_esclarecimento: AKA potassium aluminum sulfate

titulo: Severe allergic reaction after previous dose of Rabies
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of Rabies vaccine.

titulo: End stage renal disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have end stage renal disease.
texto_esclarecimento: includes dialysis patients

titulo: Severe allergic reaction to protamine sulfate
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to protamine sulfate.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction after previous dose of Meningococcal B
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of Meningococcal B vaccine.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction to diphtheria toxoid
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to diphtheria toxoid.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction to tetanus toxoid
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to tetanus toxoid.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction after previous dose of cholera
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of cholera vaccine.

Homelessness
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who are experiencing homelessness.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction after previous dose of COVID-19
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of COVID-19 vaccine.

titulo: Severe allergic reaction after previous dose of Ebola
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction after a previous dose of Ebola vaccine.

texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had a severe allergic reaction to rice protein.

titulo: Tetanus IG administration
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Tetanus IG administered in the previous 3 months.

titulo: Hep A IG administration
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Hepatitis A IG administered in the previous 6 months.

titulo: Hep B IG administration
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Hepatitis B IG administered in the previous 3 months.

titulo: Rabies IG administration
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Rabies IG administered in the previous 4 months.

titulo: Varicella IG administration
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Varicella IG administered in the previous 5 months.

titulo: Measles prophylaxis IG administration - Standard
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Measles IG at a standard dose [0.25 mL/kg] administered in the previous 5 months.

titulo: Measles prophylaxis IG administration - Immunocompromised Contact
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has had Measles IG at an immunocompromised dose [0.5 mL/kg] administered in the previous 6 months.

titulo: RBC [adenine-saline added] blood transfusion
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received a blood transfusion of adenine-saline added RBCs in the previous 3 months.

titulo: Packed RBC blood transfusion
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received a blood transfusion of packed RBCs in the previous 6 months.

titulo: Whole blood transfusion
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received a whole blood transfusion in the previous 6 months.

titulo: Plasma/platelet products blood transfusion
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received a blood transfusion of plasma or platelet product in the previous 7 months.

titulo: Cytomegalovirus IGIV
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received Cytomegalovirus IGIV in the previous 6 months.

titulo: IGIV - Replacement therapy for immune deficiencies
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received IGIV [Replacement therapy for immune deficiencies] in the previous 8 months.

titulo: IGIV - Immune thrombocytopenic purpura treatment
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received IGIV [Immune thrombocytopenic purpura treatment [400 mg/kg IV]] in the previous 8 months.
texto_esclarecimento: 400 mg/kg IV

titulo: IGIV - Postexposure varicella prophylaxis
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received IGIV [Postexposure varicella prophylaxis] in the previous 8 months.

titulo: IGIV - Immune thrombocytopenic purpura treatment
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received IGIV [Immune thrombocytopenic purpura treatment [1000 mg/kg IV]] in the previous 10 months.
texto_esclarecimento: 1000 mg/kg IV

titulo: IGIV - Kawasaki disease
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has received IGIV [Kawasaki disease] in the previous 11 months.

titulo: Travel to or working in countries that have high or intermediate endemicity of Hepatitis A
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons traveling to or working in countries that have high or intermediate endemicity of Hepatitis A.

titulo: Travel to areas or countries where polio is epidemic or endemic
texto_indicacao: Administer to travelers to areas or countries where polio is epidemic or endemic.

titulo: International travel with possible contact with animals in areas where rabies is enzootic and immediate access to appropriate medical care might be limited
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons with plans for international travel with possible contact with animals in areas where rabies is enzootic and immediate access to appropriate medical care might be limited.
texto_esclarecimento: PrEP considerations include whether the travelers 1) will be performing occupational or recreational activities that increase risk for exposure to potentially rabid animals (particularly dogs) and 2) might have difficulty getting prompt access to safe PEP (e.g., rural part of a country or far from closest PEP clinic)

titulo: B-lymphocyte [humoral] - Severe antibody deficiencies
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have severe B-lymphocyte [humoral] - antibody deficiencies [e.g., X-linked agammaglobulinemia and common variable immunodeficiency].
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has severe B-lymphocyte [humoral] - antibody deficiencies [e.g., X-linked agammaglobulinemia and common variable immunodeficiency].
texto_esclarecimento: e.g., X-linked agammaglobulinemia and common variable immunodeficiency

titulo: B-lymphocyte [humoral] - Less severe antibody deficiencies
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have less severe B-lymphocyte [humoral] - antibody deficiencies [e.g., selective IgA deficiency and IgG subclass deficiency].
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has less severe B-lymphocyte [humoral] - antibody deficiencies [e.g., selective IgA deficiency and IgG subclass deficiency].
texto_esclarecimento: e.g., selective IgA deficiency and IgG subclass deficiency

titulo: T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - Complete defects
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have complete cell-mediated or humoral T-lymphocyte defects [e.g., severe combined immunodeficiency [SCID] disease, complete DiGeorge syndrome].
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has complete cell-mediated or humoral T-lymphocyte defects [e.g., severe combined immunodeficiency [SCID] disease, complete DiGeorge syndrome].
texto_esclarecimento: e.g., severe combined immunodeficiency [SCID] disease, complete DiGeorge syndrome

titulo: T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - Partial defects
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have partial cell-mediated or humoral T-lymphocyte defects [e.g., most patients with DiGeorge syndrome, Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome, ataxia- telangiectasia].
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has partial cell-mediated or humoral T-lymphocyte defects [e.g., most patients with DiGeorge syndrome, Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome, ataxia- telangiectasia].
texto_esclarecimento: e.g., most patients with DiGeorge syndrome, Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome, ataxia- telangiectasia

titulo: T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - interferon-gamma/Interleukin 12 axis deficiencies
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - interferon-gamma or interferon-alpha.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate with live attenuated typhoid virus [Ty21a] if the patient has T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - interferon-gamma/Interleukin 12 axis deficiencies.

titulo: T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - interferon-gamma or interferon-alpha deficiencies
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have T-lymphocyte [cell-mediated and humoral] - interferon-gamma or interferon-alpha deficiencies.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has cell-mediated or humoral T-lymphocyte defects related to interferon-gamma or interferon-alpha deficiencies.

titulo: Persistent complement, properdin, or factor B deficiency
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have persistent complement component deficiencies, including inherited or chronic deficiencies in C3, C5-9, properdin, factor D, factor H, or who are taking eculizumab [Soliris].

titulo: Phagocytic function - Chronic granulomatous disease
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have chronic granulomatous disease.
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has phagocytic function - chronic granulomatous disease.

titulo: Phagocytic function - Leukocyte adhesion defect, and myeloperoxidase deficiency
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have a phagocytic function defect [e.g. leukocyte adhesion defect and myeloperoxidase deficiency].
texto_contraindicacao: Do not vaccinate if the patient has a phagocytic function defect [e.g. leukocyte adhesion defect and myeloperoxidase deficiency].
texto_esclarecimento: Phagocytic deficiencies that are undefined or accompanied by defects in T-cell and NK cell dysfunction (such as a Chediak-Higashi syndrome, Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency [LAD], and myeloperoxidase deficiency)

titulo: HIV/AIDS - severely immunocompromised
texto_indicacao: Administer to persons who have HIV/AIDS and are severely immunocompromised [See the CDC general recommendations for a definition of "severely immunocompromised"].
